Card Q&A.a: Yes, the effect will activate since a Digimon with [Seadramon] in its name was played earlier.
Card Q&A.q: If I don't have any Digimon with [Seadramon] in its name, and use this card's effect to play a Digimon card Seadramon] in its name from the digivolution cards of one of my blue Digimon, does the effect to "return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck" activate?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 blue Digimon card from one of your blue Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost. Then, if you have a Digimon with [Seadramon] in its name in play, return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
